name: Ellsworth AFB
description: Home of the 28th Bomb Wing. Ellsworth AFB operates B-1B Lancer conventional bomber missions and supports global strike operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Liberty Gate (Main)
gates.notes: Only 24/7 gate. Visitor Control Center located here. Use for RV/FamCamp access.
gates.address: 1940 EP Howe Drive, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

gates.name: Bismarck Gate (Commercial)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Weekday commuter and commercial gate near I-90.

gates.name: Patriot Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Weekday commuter gate near I-90. Restricted to authorized personnel without VCC pass.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Liberty Gate)
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Phone: 605-385-2895.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Pine Tree Inn (605-385-2844) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (605-385-2569) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 28 FSS, M&FRC, and official Ellsworth sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
